title: Different examples yield a fair conclusion

captions.emotions: Feeling a conclusion has fair proportions

meaning: Your shared view can connect different sides of a question when visible comparisons help a conclusion feel appropriately proportioned.
text: Understanding something together can mean seeing why two different answers both have a foundation. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests creating concrete possibilities to compare. Temperance in energy supports a wish to connect differing aspects, understand their relationship and find a workable measure. Justice in emotions responds with the feeling of a fair conclusion, the pleasure of no significant reason being lost. You can preserve the question’s particular features while recognising the appropriate scale of each solution, without demanding that only one side be right.

For example, you make two trial schedules for a day off: one containing a long walk and another several smaller activities. Comparison reveals different needs for conversation and personal interest. **A proportionate conclusion gives differences an understandable place in a shared picture.** Beyond mechanically dividing the day in half, you see which parts actually need shared time. The explanation feels satisfying because it accounts for both intentions. A particular day can now be discussed.

The difficulty is assessing every detail by the discovered measure, as though any difference requires exact compensation. A shared picture becomes an account although you sought it for understanding. Interest in reconciliation remains constructive when it considers what different parts are for. A fair conclusion can be accurate enough for this situation without turning into an obligatory proportion for every day that follows.
